name: app-sage-glass-ai-study-notes-three-screens
title: Sage Glass AI Study Notes Screens
whatItIs: Three phones on a pale ground: a study home with a trial card and pastel folders, a recording sheet with a soft green blur orb, and a paywall listing AI features with pricing and a dark subscribe button.
whatItMeans: Frosted blurs and muted sage feel calm and focused, ideal for study, and the dark buttons give clear stopping points.
techniques: Blurred colour orb as the hero graphic on the recording screen
Pastel blurred folder tiles with tiny icons
Dark pill as the sole high-contrast action
Bottom sheet that dims the screen behind
Two-tone titles with grey first line

vocabulary.definition: A soft blurred blob used as an abstract illustration.
A panel that slides up from the bottom of a screen.
A screen that offers a paid plan.
